request.title: 知识用途筛选、去重与历史修订
request.description:
C02 recorded synthetic alert materials copied unchanged into new local identities; no asserted real-world authorization.
Real local PostgreSQL and Qdrant, real existing local embedding service reached by SSH tunnel, real analysis model reached by existing SSH adapter.
Original KB ingest/index and Case HTTP routes/services/storage; only authentication and model transport are adapted. Local general API connection is explicitly the developer role, unlike production aisoc_app.
One Case and one Run; no repeated model sampling. Known M01-A/M01-B remain deferred and model quality NOT_PASSED.
No vendor/ClickHouse calls configured; unavailable sources and untriggered branches retain actual meanings.
Historical card source is a new explicit synthetic fixture (2026-11-01); its assessment and human statement are test data, not genuine business history, authorization or truth. Current C02 materials remain unchanged.
One explicit historical feedback revision before this Run; old card retained and excluded from fresh retrieval. Curated applicability tags on one source-preserving method document. No automatic import.

findings.statement: A1、A2、A3 在时间上紧密关联（间隔<2 分钟），且共享同一主机、用户及来源 IP，存在逻辑上的行为序列关联。
limitations: 无进程树证明父子关系

questions.text: 原始记录支持哪些行为和对象？
evidence_requirements: 原始材料和具体来源；检测标签本身不是攻击事实
questions.answer: 原始记录证实用户 flow-observer 从 IP 203.0.113.77 成功登录主机 socai2-flow-20261107-01（A1），随后启动 powershell.exe 执行 Get-LocalUser 命令（A3），并在 1 分钟内向 IP 198.51.100.77 的 443 端口发起成功 TCP 连接（A2）。

questions.text: 成员告警之间有哪些已证实的行为联系？
evidence_requirements: 同对象、时间邻近与有证据的行为连接分开
questions.answer: A1 与 A3 共享同一主机、用户及时间窗口，且 A1 的登录发生在 A3 的进程启动之前，存在逻辑上的时序关联。A2 与 A1/A3 共享同一主机和时间窗口，且发生在 A3 之后，存在行为序列上的邻近性，但无直接证据表明 A2 是 A3 命令的直接结果。
limitations: 无进程树证明父子关系

questions.text: 恶意、正常或误操作等解释分别有哪些依据和反证？
evidence_requirements: 可追溯行为证据与替代解释；不以单个标签或分数定性
questions.answer: 恶意解释依据：Get-LocalUser 常用于攻击者枚举账户；登录后立即外连符合 C2 或数据窃取模式。正常解释依据：flow-observer 可能是运维账户，Get-LocalUser 用于排查，外连为更新工具或报告。反证：标签 synthetic 暗示测试环境；无命令输出无法确认枚举成功；无数据外传证据。
limitations: 缺乏命令输出确认枚举

questions.text: 谁确认了哪些行为、对象和时间的授权？
evidence_requirements: 明确授权材料或人工反馈及适用范围；未提供不等于不存在
questions.answer: 当前材料未提供任何审批记录、工单或人工确认，无法证明登录、命令执行或网络连接已获业务授权。

questions.text: 哪些影响已经观察到，哪些只是待核的可能影响？
evidence_requirements: 影响对象、行为与证据；图可达不等于受影响
questions.answer: 已观察到动作：登录、进程启动、网络连接。未确认影响：Get-LocalUser 是否成功获取用户列表；出站连接是否传输了敏感数据；是否造成系统配置变更。

case.description:
C02 recorded synthetic alert materials copied unchanged into new local identities; no asserted real-world authorization.
Real local PostgreSQL and Qdrant, real existing local embedding service reached by SSH tunnel, real analysis model reached by existing SSH adapter.
Original KB ingest/index and Case HTTP routes/services/storage; only authentication and model transport are adapted. Local general API connection is explicitly the developer role, unlike production aisoc_app.
One Case and one Run; no repeated model sampling. Known M01-A/M01-B remain deferred and model quality NOT_PASSED.
No vendor/ClickHouse calls configured; unavailable sources and untriggered branches retain actual meanings.
Historical card source is a new explicit synthetic fixture (2026-11-01); its assessment and human statement are test data, not genuine business history, authorization or truth. Current C02 materials remain unchanged.
One explicit historical feedback revision before this Run; old card retained and excluded from fresh retrieval. Curated applicability tags on one source-preserving method document. No automatic import.
